subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should OpenClaw add a supported way to suppress inbound Feishu file text extraction, and should that control live in Feishu config or the shared media-understanding/file-extraction policy?
rationale: Current source proves the behavior path, but adding or reviving a config key changes public configuration policy and may duplicate a shared media pipeline concern.

options.title: Shared Media Policy
options.body: Add or document a shared inbound file-extraction allow/deny policy that can target Feishu/channel/account scope without creating a Feishu-only special case.

options.title: Feishu-Specific Setting
options.body: Add a documented Feishu per-account setting that skips attachment download or text extraction, with schema, docs, and focused tests for file messages.

options.title: No New Setting
options.body: Keep current file extraction behavior and document the existing global media/file limits as the supported mitigation for large attachments.

recommendation.title: Shared Media Policy
recommendation.body: Add or document a shared inbound file-extraction allow/deny policy that can target Feishu/channel/account scope without creating a Feishu-only special case.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu community maintainer, and the choice affects Feishu channel policy.
